sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-08 and 2016-12-08, internal automated monitoring identified suspicious transaction activity on card C02923-K1 belonging to customer C02923. Flagged transaction 3523199 in the amount of $100.07 was executed via card not present new device. The transaction was initiated from an unrecognized device (iOS Device | iOS 9.3.5 | mobile safari 9.0 | 1024x768). Cross-account analysis revealed this device fingerprint is concurrently linked to multiple cardholder accounts (C08299-K1), indicating organized multi-card harvesting or syndicate involvement. Historical case memory retrieved relevant precedents (CC-1998, CC-1997) with confirmed fraud typologies. The financial institution has initiated preventive containment including card blocking and heightened monitoring of linked accounts. Total suspicious activity identified amounts to $100.07. This report is filed pursuant to regulatory requirements under Rule R2/R6.

stop_reason: Graph pattern and customer validation definitively confirmed unauthorized compromise. Containment actions established.
